name: E-commerce Order & Inventory Sync | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## E-commerce Order & Inventory Sync
Each new Shopify or WooCommerce order is logged, the stock of every SKU sold is reduced in your Google Sheet inventory, and you get an email when a product reaches its low-stock threshold or an order contains a SKU that is not in the sheet.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Make a sheet with **Inventory** and **Orders** tabs (CSV files). 3. Connect Shopify (access token) and/or WooCommerce; disable the trigger you do not use. 4. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail. 5. Activate.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Fill in these values before activating.
